items.title: Dashboard creator user ID
items.description: Admin demonstration cards now show the creator user ID and dashboard search can match creator IDs.

releases.summary: SEO landing pages, crawlability, social metadata, and structured data improvements.

items.title: For organizers SEO page
items.description: ChantLive now has a public organizer-focused page that explains the QR code live chant workflow for events.

items.title: About ChantLive page
items.description: A new public about page gives civic-tech, accessibility, and community sites a clearer page to link to.

items.title: Public internal links
items.description: The homepage now links to the organizer and about pages so visitors and crawlers can discover them.

items.title: Sitemap and structured data updates
items.description: The sitemap and route-specific JSON-LD now include the new public SEO pages.

items.title: Social preview metadata
items.description: Open Graph and Twitter preview metadata now include image dimensions, alt text, and a corrected social card caption.

releases.summary: Dashboard filtering, QR copy feedback, and participant retry improvements.

items.title: Dashboard search
items.description: Organizers can search demonstrations by title to find the right event faster.

items.title: Dashboard status filters
items.description: Organizers can filter demonstrations by all, live, draft, or ended status before opening an event.

items.title: Filtered empty state
items.description: When dashboard filters return no results, organizers see a clear message and one-click reset action.

items.title: QR link copy feedback
items.description: Admins now get visible and screen-reader-friendly confirmation after copying a participant link.

items.title: Participant retry controls
items.description: Participants can retry loading or failed join attempts without being stuck on a dead-end screen.

releases.summary: Admin user activity and demonstration visibility improvements.

items.title: Admin user metrics
items.description: Super admins can see when each user joined, when they were last active, and how many demonstrations they can manage.

items.title: User activity tracking
items.description: Authenticated admin activity is now recorded so super admins can identify recently active users.

items.title: Safer admin user API
items.description: The admin user list now returns display-safe user summaries instead of raw account rows.

releases.summary: Live-event readiness, QR joining, participant waiting, and trust improvements.

items.title: Chant starter examples
items.description: Organizers can fill the add-chant form from common call-and-response examples instead of starting from a blank dialog.

items.title: Live readiness reminder
items.description: Admins see a pre-live reminder to add chants, test the participant link, and invite backup admins before an event starts.

items.title: QR join instructions
items.description: The QR dialog now gives participants clearer scanning and page-open instructions for crowded live settings.

items.title: Participant waiting guidance
items.description: Participants waiting for a draft demonstration now know to keep the page open because chants will appear automatically.

items.title: Landing page trust cards
items.description: First-time visitors now see clearer privacy, mobile-use, and open-source trust signals before signing up.

releases.summary: Customer-facing onboarding, organiser workflow, participant reliability, and QR sharing improvements.

items.title: Clearer event use cases
items.description: First-time visitors can quickly see that ChantLive supports marches, prayer circles, campus actions, and community gatherings.

items.title: Dashboard status summary
items.description: Organizers can scan total, live, draft, and ended demonstrations before opening an event.

items.title: Quick title starters
items.description: Organizers can start new demonstrations faster with common title prompts in the create dialog.

items.title: Participant connection status
items.description: Participants can see and hear whether live updates are connected or reconnecting.

items.title: QR fallback guidance
items.description: Admins get clear fallback guidance for sharing the participant link when QR scanning is difficult.

releases.summary: Deployment monitoring, QR accessibility, and issue-reporting improvements.

items.title: Health check endpoint
items.description: Deployments and uptime monitors can check /healthz for status, version, uptime, and timestamp.

items.title: Bug report issue template
items.description: Contributors can report reproducible bugs with clear steps, expected behavior, environment, and safety checks.

items.title: QR accessibility checklist
items.description: Organizers have practical guidance for sharing participant QR codes with URL fallbacks and scan testing.

items.title: Release health checks
items.description: The release checklist now includes health endpoint and QR sharing verification steps.

items.title: Health endpoint documentation
items.description: README now documents the /healthz endpoint for uptime and deployment monitoring.

releases.summary: Public release notes workflow and changelog visibility improvements.

items.title: Public changelog page
items.description: Community members can review recent ChantLive releases directly on the website.

items.title: Structured release notes data
items.description: Release notes now have a structured source of truth for website, markdown, and automation output.

items.title: Release note scripts
items.description: Maintainers can add, import, and generate changelog entries from npm scripts.

items.title: Release item issue template
items.description: Feature requests can capture user impact and proposed public changelog wording.

items.title: Release item workflow
items.description: Repository automation can record approved release-note items into the structured changelog.

releases.summary: Security, accessibility, deployment, and release communication improvements.

items.title: Baseline HTTP security headers
items.description: API and page responses now include baseline security headers.

items.title: Reduced motion support
items.description: Animations now respect users who prefer reduced motion.

items.title: Screen reader live chant announcements
items.description: Participant chant updates are announced to assistive technologies.

items.title: Release checklist
items.description: Deployment verification steps and common Replit Git recovery notes are documented.

items.title: Project changelog
items.description: Community members can now review project changes before deploying or contributing.
